In the Soviet Union state capitalism ( by Lenin's words in "new economic policy") just perpetuated both social stratification and the role of the state as the sole owner of the production means. The working class became isolated from the production and the pricing and in the process indifferent to regime's peril . The state never became obsolete .

In Yugoslavia the workers did acquire (some) means of production ( through worker owned factories) yet this was always under the umbrella of the state so there was little incentive to improve since efficiency and working hours invested never translated in more earnings for the investors.
